title: After the WhatsApp check, a screen reader is not told whether the gym was found
what: When a member comes back from WhatsApp, the screen changes on its own to Checking, then to either the gym that was found or Not found. None of these changes is read out, so a blind member hears nothing and must hunt around the screen to learn the result.
expected: The result (found at this gym, or not found) is read out as soon as it shows.
fix_line: Read out the found or not-found line when the check finishes

title: On the start-up error screen, a failed Save my data file is not read out
what: If saving the data file fails (the phone cannot share, no file, or the save broke), the reason appears as small grey text under the buttons. A screen reader does not say it, so a blind member thinks the file was saved.
expected: The save result is read out when it appears.
who: members using a screen reader whose app cannot open
fix_line: Make the save result line one that is read out when it appears

title: Got it, Open Profile and Skip look like plain words, not buttons
what: On the one-time Workout-tab note, Got it is plain grey words and Open Profile plain orange words, with no outline or underline. On the intro screens, Skip is plain grey words in the corner. Elsewhere on the welcome, text buttons are underlined, so these read as labels to a first-time user.
expected: Every text button shows it can be tapped, as the underlined links on the welcome do.
fix_line: Give these text buttons the same underline or outline as the other welcome links
